title: Frontend Intern
description:
About the Role  
We are looking for a passionate and curious **Frontend Intern** to join our team. You will work closely with designers, backend engineers, and product managers to build intuitive, scalable, and high\-quality user interfaces for our CLM platform and upcoming AI\-powered solutions.  
This is a great opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in a fast\-paced SaaS environment and contribute to real product features used by customers.

Key Responsibilities  
Assist in developing responsive and user\-friendly web interfaces  
Collaborate with designers to translate UI/UX wireframes into code  
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient frontend code  
Participate in code reviews and team discussions  
Help optimize applications for performance and scalability  
Debug and fix UI issues  
Ensure cross\-browser compatibility  
Support integration with backend APIs  
Stay updated with latest frontend trends and best practices

Required Skills  
Basic understanding of **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**  
Familiarity with modern frameworks (React preferred)  
Understanding of responsive design principles  
Basic knowledge of Git/version control  
Strong problem\-solving mindset  
Good communication and willingness to learn

Good to Have  
Experience with React.js or similar frameworks  
Knowledge of REST APIs  
Understanding of UI/UX principles  
Familiarity with TypeScript  
Exposure to component libraries  
Basic understanding of web performance optimization

What You’ll Learn  
Real\-world product development lifecycle  
Working in an Agile environment  
Collaboration with cross\-functional teams  
Writing production\-quality code  
Building scalable SaaS interfaces  
Exposure to AI\-driven product development

Who Should Apply  
Students or recent graduates in Computer Science, IT, or related fields  
Candidates with strong learning mindset and curiosity  
Individuals passionate about building great user experiences  
Self\-motivated team players

What We Offer  
Hands\-on experience working on real product features  
Mentorship from experienced engineers  
Learning\-focused environment  
Opportunity to convert to full\-time role based on performance  
Exposure to cutting\-edge CLM and AI technology

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Frontend Developer (React Native)
description:
1 **Sr. Resource: Frontend**

* Required skills:

o React Native

o Next.js 15

o TypeScript

o Zod

o Mantine v9

o Custom Hook \& State Architecture

o REST API Integration

* Preferred skills:

o Azure

o Authentication \& Security

o CI/CD Pipelines

**Based on above skill sets:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain scalable, production\-grade frontend applications using React Native and Next.js 15
* Write fully typed, maintainable code in TypeScript across all layers of the frontend stack
* Define and enforce runtime data validation using Zod for API responses, form inputs and shared data contracts
* Develop rich, accessible UI components and layouts using Mantine v9, including theming, responsive design and component customisation
* Design and implement custom hooks and state architecture patterns that promote reusability, testability and separation of concerns
* Integrate frontend applications with backend REST APIs — handling authentication flows, error states, loading states and data caching
* Collaborate with backend engineers to define API contracts and ensure type\-safe end\-to\-end data flows
* Participate in code reviews, technical planning and sprint ceremonies
* Maintain frontend documentation, component libraries and coding standards

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Required Skills \& Experience**

Skill: Detail

React 19 : Strong hands\-on experience with React 19 including concurrent features, transitions and the latest hooks patterns

Next.js 15 :Production experience with Next.js 15 — App Router, Server Components, Server Actions, routing and rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR)

TypeScript : Advanced TypeScript proficiency — generics, utility types, discriminated unions, strict mode

Zod : Experience using Zod for schema definition, validation and type inference across API boundaries and forms

Mantine v9 : Hands\-on experience with Mantine v9 component library — theming, custom components, form integration and responsive layouts

Custom Hook \& State Architecture : Proven ability to design clean custom hook patterns, manage complex local and global state, and structure frontend codebases for scale

REST API Integration : Solid experience consuming REST APIs — handling async data fetching, error boundaries, optimistic updates and token\-based authentication

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Preferred Skills \& Experience

Skill : Detail

Azure : Familiarity with Azure Static Web Apps, Azure CDN, Azure DevOps or Azure AD / Entra ID for frontend hosting and identity

Authentication \& Security : Working knowledge of OAuth 2\.0, JWT handling, secure token storage, PKCE flows and protecting frontend routes

CI/CD Pipelines: Experience setting up or maintaining frontend CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or equivalent — including build, lint, test and deploy stages

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

What We're Looking For

* A frontend engineer who thinks in systems — not just components
* Strong understanding of web performance, Core Web Vitals and accessibility (WCAG) fundamentals
* Comfortable working in an Agile / Scrum environment with regular releases and evolving requirements
* A collaborative team player who engages proactively with designers, backend engineers and product stakeholders
* Attention to detail in both code quality and visual output

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

title: React Developer – Fresher Program
description:
**Fresher to Full\-Time Opportunity**

We're looking for passionate and self\-motivated **React Developers** who are eager to learn, build, and grow while working on real\-world products. You'll work alongside experienced developers to build modern, responsive web applications using React and related frontend technologies.

This opportunity is open to **final\-year students, fresh graduates, or candidates with up to 1 year of experience**.

Responsibilities

* Develop responsive and interactive web applications using **React.js**, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Convert UI/UX designs into pixel\-perfect, responsive user interfaces.
* Build reusable React components and maintain clean, scalable code.
* Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs.
* Debug, test, and optimize applications for performance.
* Collaborate with designers, backend developers, and QA teams.

Tech Stack You'll Work With

* React.js
* JavaScript (ES6\+)
* HTML5
* CSS3
* Bootstrap / Tailwind CSS
* REST APIs
* Git

Requirements

* Good understanding of React.js, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Familiarity with React Hooks, Components, Props, State Management, and API integration.
* Ability to build responsive and user\-friendly web interfaces.
* Understanding of responsive design principles.
* Basic knowledge of Git and version control.
* Good problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Bachelor's degree (or pursuing final year) in Computer Science or a related field.
* Portfolio, GitHub, or personal React projects will be an added advantage.

What You'll Gain

* Hands\-on experience working on live products.
* Mentorship from experienced developers.
* Exposure to modern frontend architecture and development practices.
* Opportunity to build production\-ready applications.
* Performance\-based Letter of Recommendation.
* Opportunity to transition into a full\-time React Developer role based on performance.

Fresher to Full\-Time Opportunity

* **First 3\-6 Months:** ₹5,000/month \+ Conveyance Allowance up to ₹1,500/month.
* **Post 3\-6 Months:** Performance\-based opportunity to transition into a **Full\-Time React Developer** role with a salary of **₹10,000/month \+ ₹1,500/month Conveyance Allowance**.
